prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce ONE standalone landscape 16:9 cinematic environment image.
Image 1 is the edit target and authoritative for composition, exact architecture, purple crystal exchange building, daylight, left bronze charging bull, right semicircular purple stage, golden star emblem backdrop, podium, plants and central entrance. Image 2 is ONLY a high-end feature-film CGI material/detail quality reference; do NOT import its character, room, ornaments or nighttime palette.
Modify only the elevation of stage and bull pedestal. Preserve the camera position and full building framing.
RIGHT STAGE: rebuild the existing low platform into a clearly elevated ceremonial podium, approximately 1.5 metres above the audience plaza, with a substantial vertical purple stone front fascia and restrained gold trim. It must read as a high stage where a standing speaker is above the crowd's eye level. Keep the same stage footprint and right-side location. Lift the entire stage floor, lectern and arched star backdrop together so lectern stays on top and backdrop remains behind the floor. Add coherent access stairs at the outer right flank, with realistic continuous steps and discreet matching handrail; keep central entrance stairway and plaza passage unobstructed. Do not replace the tall stage fascia with only a broad shallow staircase.
LEFT BULL: preserve identical bronze bull sculpture size, anatomy, charging pose and direction, all four hooves supported; raise it on a substantial approximately 1.1 metre tall oval stone plinth with restrained purple stone panels and gold edging, rather than the old thin slab. Lift sculpture with its pedestal. Complete sculpture, horns and pedestal remain fully in frame, do not enlarge or crop bull.
Maintain visual balance between monumental bull and ceremonial stage; visible empty audience plaza in foreground. No people, no labels, no text, no collage. Preserve original sky, building silhouette, purple/gold palette and daylight. High-end feature-film CGI, physically based distinct bronze, polished stone and translucent purple crystal; crisp architectural detail, natural contact shadows, controlled highlights, no plastic, smeared texture or excessive bloom. This is a local architectural height revision, no redesign of the rest of the scene.
